title: docs(api): Rewrite some content on the InstantSearch API page
body:
I fixed some inconsistencies I went through when reading the [InstantSearch API](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/instantsearch.html) page.

* Deprecate `urlSync`
* Add a CSS rule to avoid empty `code` tags to display ([see "widget" here](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/instantsearch.html#struct-addWidget)).
